submission.justification: Radiator-R3 at 3cm thickness is the recommended configuration. It achieves 3.8σ pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c, which exceeds the minimum requirement of 3.5σ and represents the best performance among all configurations that meet both hard requirements. R3 passes the humidity ageing test, ensuring long-term reliability without replacement. While R2 offers higher separation (4.6σ), it fails the humidity test and is disqualified. R1 passes the humidity test but cannot achieve the required 3.5σ separation at any thickness. Among R3's valid thicknesses (2-4cm), the 3cm configuration provides the optimal separation performance.
